author: Good Enough
description:
He was just learning how to use a metal detector, and then made an incredible discovery.

While still a beginner, Kevin Hillier uncovered one of the largest gold nuggets ever found, proving that sometimes experience isn’t what leads to success, timing and luck can change everything in an instant.

This Short tells the story of how a simple day of learning turned into one of the most unbelievable gold discoveries ever.
title: He Was Learning... Then Found Massive Gold 🥇😲 #gold #goldrush #history #shorts #didyouknow
